layouts.name: CAtlasedRectsVisual_GetAtlasImageCount
layouts.notes: CAtlasedRectsVisual::InsertAtlasImageAtIndex increments the DWORD at +272 and RemoveAtlasImage decrements it; CButton::RedrawVisual also uses the same array count. Verified on uDWM 22000.194 and 22621.6630. On uDWM 26100.7705, AddAtlasImage instead reads the current count from +224 and forwards to InsertAtlasImageAtIndex. ButtonGlowHandler consumes the +272 Layout only before build 26100; build 26100+ follows the semantic AddAtlasImage path, so the old Layout correctly remains unsupported.
